purpose: Acquire historical civilian-harm evidence independently of Pineland residuals for Nepal 2001-2006 and Afghanistan 2004-2021.

nepal_2001_2006.geography: all frozen Nepal study districts; no district is selected because of Pineland fit

minimum_confirmatory_coverage.direct_harm: at least two non-model source families with actor/date/geography attribution or an explicitly documented national surveillance series
minimum_confirmatory_coverage.displacement_or_resource_loss: at least one independent source family with dated displacement or civilian property/resource-loss measurement

afghanistan_2004_2021.geography: all frozen Afghanistan study districts/provinces/national aggregates accepted only at their source-supported resolution; no area selected because of Pineland fit

minimum_confirmatory_coverage.direct_harm: at least two non-model source families or one audited long-run surveillance system plus an independent overlap cross-check
minimum_confirmatory_coverage.displacement_or_resource_loss: at least one independent longitudinal displacement/resource-loss series
minimum_confirmatory_coverage.uncertainty: source uncertainty, access limitations, attribution rules, and temporal coverage explicitly retained

direct_harm: civilian-specific victimization with attributable actor or incident context
displacement_or_resource_loss: livelihood/resource loss directly attributable to conflict or policy

inadmissible_as_substitutes: total battle deaths without civilian identification
generic refugee stock without conflict/date/geographic attribution
candidate_source_family_classes: conflict casualty datasets with explicit civilian classification
archival field reports with source-level provenance

allowed_search_terms: human rights annual report/protection of civilians
source_discovery_protocol.opened_source_logging: Every source document opened after this contract must be entered into civilian_harm_source_exposure_log_v1.csv whether usable, unusable, supportive, or contradictory.
source_discovery_protocol.source_family_dependence: Syndicated, derivative, or repeated editions from the same originating monitoring system count as one source family unless independence is documented.

confirmatory_use_gate: candidate exposure log complete for all opened sources
coding schema frozen before extracting outcome values
matching model harm components prospectively retained before any future model comparison
